Evidence: 7,043 rows and 10 columns loaded from the official dataset.
302 identical rows (4.29%) were retained. The source has no customer identifier, so identical profiles cannot be proven to be accidental duplicates.
Training rows: 5,634; testing rows: 1,409; stratified 80/20 split.
Churn is excluded from all model input features.
No generated or source customer identifier is used as a model feature.
Encoder and scaler are fitted on training data only; the fitted pipeline is then applied to testing data.
Training and testing sets use the same 16 features in the same order.
No missing or infinite values remain in the ANN model inputs.
